highlights: Event details no longer show you internal machine values. Things like batch ids and schema versions were rendering as raw code-looking text — on around 13,000 events — and are now hidden
The event details that ARE yours now have proper names instead of raw field names: rain gauge readings, target pest, active ingredient, loss reason and nine others

The Add Seeds screen no longer offers "Photo of packets" and "Paste an order". Neither has ever actually worked — they need a service that was never set up — so they now stay hidden rather than failing when tapped. Adding seeds one at a time is unaffected
